title: Behind the Advert
text:
Advertising is designed to catch our attention in just a few seconds. Companies use bright colours, catchy slogans and famous faces to make products seem more attractive. Many people believe they are not affected by adverts, yet they often remember a brand name without realising why. For this reason, advertisers spend large amounts of money on television and social media.

However, media literacy can help viewers recognise these techniques. A critical reader asks who created the message and what it wants them to buy. Furthermore, a sponsored post may look like a normal recommendation, so readers should check whether it is labelled as an advert. As a result, people who understand advertising tend to make more careful choices.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what do companies use to make products seem more attractive?
options: Bright colours, catchy slogans and famous faces

questions.text: What does the second paragraph say a critical reader asks?
options: Who created the message and what it wants them to buy
How much the company paid for the advert
Why the newspaper was printed in colour

questions.text: Why might people remember a brand name without realising why?
options: Advertising affects them without them noticing it
They have studied the brand at school
The brand name is written in a foreign language
They have never seen an advert before

questions.text: What can the reader infer about someone who understands advertising techniques?
options: They are more likely to make careful decisions
They never buy anything that is advertised
They work in the advertising industry
They prefer television to social media

vocabulary.definition: pleasing and likely to attract interest
used to show a contrast with what was said before
paid for by a company in exchange for promotion
paying attention in order to avoid mistakes or risks

paragraph_translations: A publicidade foi criada para chamar a nossa atenção em apenas alguns segundos. As empresas usam cores vivas, slogans marcantes e rostos famosos para tornar os produtos mais atraentes. Muitas pessoas acreditam que não são influenciadas por anúncios, mas frequentemente lembram o nome de uma marca sem perceber o motivo. Por isso, os anunciantes gastam grandes quantias de dinheiro na televisão e nas redes sociais.

No entanto, a educação para a mídia pode ajudar os espectadores a reconhecer essas técnicas. Um leitor crítico pergunta quem criou a mensagem e o que ela quer que ele compre. Além disso, uma publicação patrocinada pode parecer uma recomendação normal, por isso os leitores devem verificar se ela está identificada como anúncio. Como resultado, as pessoas que entendem a publicidade tendem a fazer escolhas mais cuidadosas.
